question: Can original M-TARE produce ten exact, mobile, type-correct AEE development trajectories that expose the registered-scan domain required for objective structural-semantic head adaptation?
method: Run original M-TARE serially in tunnel and garage for seeds 11/23/37/53/71. After the first valid waypoint, collect exactly 3000 synchronized registered_scan and state_estimation_at_scan frames per trajectory, require at least 50 m travel, and retain every fifth frame for an exact 600-sample sensor shard. Archive each raw bag on the host with frozen zstd-10 and verify the decompressed SHA-256 before removing the raw bag.
baseline: The frozen topic/range-image contracts and original M-TARE trajectory generator are the collection baseline. There is no learned method, teacher, fallback, retry or alternative sampler in this run.

user_authorization.scope: AEE tunnel train and garage validation, five seeds each, exactly ten trajectories, 30000 raw synchronized frames and 6000 every-fifth effective sensor samples; host-side lossless archives; zero teacher/model/training/C09/C10.
user_authorization.confirmation_reference: After Gate-6 V1 domain-failure evidence and the exact AEE adaptation data/teacher/training plan were shown, the user replied '批准'.

acceptance_criteria: Exactly ten unique trajectories use tunnel=train and garage=validation with environment/planner seeds 11/23/37/53/71 and original M-TARE test_id 0001.

Every trajectory contains exactly 3000 finite synchronized frames after readiness, travels at least 50 m, passes the complete required-topic and 16x720 range/valid contracts, and creates exactly 600 samples at raw indices 0,5,...,2995.
Aggregate counts are exactly 30000 raw frames and 6000 effective samples split 3000 train/3000 validation; no outcome-selected frame deletion or reordering.
Every raw bag is zstd-10 archived on the host and decompression SHA-256 equals the original before raw removal.
Teacher queries, model inference, training/optimizer steps, C09 reads and C10 reads are zero.
stop_conditions: Any image, planner binary, world, host-zstd, tool or contract drift.
Any startup/topic/type/synchronization/count/range/off-ring/distance/archive/disk/evidence failure; stop and seal FAIL without retry.
Any teacher, model, training, C09/C10 or strict-test access.
expected_evidence: Approved Data Card, exact ten-trajectory schedule, frozen image/planner/world/tool identities and command/environment snapshots.
Ten contracts, raw logs, 600-frame sensor shards, type/range/conversion/distance audits and losslessly verified bag archives.
Exact 30000/6000 aggregate manifest, split counts, progress, final summary, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.

estimated_cost.compute: Serial CPU plus Gazebo/ROS; approximately 6000 simulation seconds; host zstd-10; zero GPU, teacher or training.
